prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Charlotte for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for implants in Charlotte — the right provider depends on your case (single implant vs. full-arch, bone grafting needs, medical history), your comfort with the clinician, your budget/insurance, and whether you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or restorative dentist. Instead of naming a single “best,” here’s a practical way to find the best implant provider for you and what to ask at a consult.

Who to look for
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons — best for surgical complexity (bone grafts, impacted teeth, medically complex patients).  
- Periodontists — specialists in gums and supporting bone; commonly place implants.  
- Prosthodontists or restorative dentists — design and restore implant crowns and full-arch prosthetics; they often work with surgeons.  
- Practices offering a full digital workflow (CBCT 3D imaging, guided surgery, digital impressions) tend to have more predictable results.

How to evaluate providers
- Board certification / specialty training (AAOMS for oral surgeons, ABO/AAID for implant specialists).  
- Years of implant experience and number/type of implants placed.  
- Before/after cases and patient photos for similar treatments to yours.  
- Use of 3D imaging (CBCT), guided implant placement, and implant brands they use.  
- Collaboration between surgeon and restorative dentist (team approach).  
- Clear treatment plan, timeline, costs, and warranty/guarantee policy.  
- Patient reviews (Google, Healthgrades, Yelp) and referral patterns from local dentists.  
- Comfortable office, sedation options, and follow-up care plan.

Questions to ask at the consultation
- How many implants like mine have you placed? Success rate?  
- Will you do the surgery and the restoration, or will another provider do the crown?  
- Do I need bone grafts/sinus lift? If so, how will that change timeline/cost?  
- What imaging will you use? Can I see before/after photos?  
- What are total costs and financing/insurance options?  
- What are the risks and how are complications handled?

Where to search/verify
- AAOMS and AAID “find a surgeon” directories.  
- ADA Find-a-Dentist and local dental society referrals.  
- Google Maps + patient reviews, and Zocdoc for booking/availability.  
- Ask your general dentist for a recommendation — they usually refer to trusted local specialists.

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated implant surgeons/periodontists in Charlotte (please give your ZIP or neighborhood), or  
- Give a short checklist tailored to a single-tooth implant vs. full-arch replacement.

Which would you prefer?
